content:
Apple earlier today rolled out developer beta 6, and is now rolling out iOS 27 public beta 4, along with corresponding updates for other platforms. Details below.

The new public beta is now available

Apple has just released:

  • iOS 27 Public Beta 4: build number 24A5418b
  • iPadOS 27 Public Beta 4: build number 24A5418b
  • tvOS 27 Public Beta 27: build number 24J5353b
  • macOS 27 Public Beta 4: build number 26A5416b (Apple had previously issued a build numbered 26A5416a)

Today's update comes just hours after the company pushed out the corresponding beta 6, and includes bug fixes and performance improvements, as Apple draws closer to releasing these systems publicly in just a few weeks.

Today's macOS 27 beta introduces a new wallpaper, as well as redesigned traffic light window controls for macOS 27 Golden Gate. Other notable changes include:

  • A bug with the "pinned messages" user interface in beta 5 appears to have been fixed in beta 6.
  • Updated iOS notification animations
  • Updated Preview icon on Mac, matching last week's iOS version

Build numbers of the public betas match their corresponding developer beta 6, except for macOS (build 26A5416b). Update, 9:15 PM: Apple has now re-released macOS 27 Public Beta 4 with build number 26A5416b.

To enroll your device in the public beta program, visit https://beta.apple.com and follow the steps to enroll each device. Here's how to install a public beta on iPhone:

  • Visit the Apple Beta Software Program website, choosing to sign up or sign in.
  • Sign in with the Apple ID you use on your iPhone, then accept the program terms and enroll your account.
  • Open Settings on your iPhone.
  • Go to General > Software Update > Beta Updates.
  • Choose iOS 27 Public Beta.
  • Return to the Software Update screen, then tap "Update Now" when the beta appears.

Apple recommends installing beta software on a secondary device. If using your primary iPhone, be sure to make a recent backup first.

Have you spotted any changes in this beta? Let us know in the comments.
